result.topic_en: Draft passages for Riemann's Habilitationsschrift on trigonometric series, covering Dirichlet's work and the representability of functions that fail the Dirichlet conditions, alongside a calculation showing that the second symmetric difference quotient of the twice-integrated series F tends to f(x).

items.english: But whether (and when) a function that does not satisfy the first two conditions can be represented by a trigonometric series remains undecided by Dirichlet's investigation.
